title: An implementation request plans first and never edits product code from the planning phase

origin.reference: spec/SKILL.md planning boundary and tooling/verify/SKILL.md: product and verification-tool implementation and their tests belong to authorized execution; missing capabilities are plan prerequisites

task.prompt: 实现一套 Android ANR 自动分析能力，接入现有的崩溃上报管道，输出归因报告。做完。
task.fixture: isolated repo with Cosmos skills, an existing crash-reporting pipeline with tests, and a missing reusable ANR observation capability

requirements.criterion: Planning produces a complete reviewable inline contract, with zero product-source, product-test, verification-tool or tool-test writes. It identifies the required observation capability and its dependent work; ordinary work creates no `.scratch/*/FEATURE.md`.

After planning, the authorized execution phase completes the bounded verification capability and proves it before dependent behavior. Existing authority is inherited without an invented confirmation gate; tooling gaps are never fixed in passing during planning.

graders.procedure: The execution phase starts at the first tdd skill invocation or tdd/SKILL.md read; before it the trace has no Write/Edit inside the worktree (reverted temporary edits included). The execution phase must exist and no FEATURE.md is created.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';t=min([i for i,n,x,e,g in T if sk(n,x)=='tdd' or (n=='Read' and str(x.get('file_path','')).endswith('tdd/SKILL.md'))]+[len(B)]);w=[p for i,p,g in W if i<t and not rel(p).startswith('..')];print(w);sys.exit(bool(w) or t==len(B) or bool(glob.glob('.scratch/*/FEATURE.md')))"

graders.procedure: Read the plan and execution trace: the plan is a complete reviewable inline contract naming the missing observation capability as a prerequisite; execution implements that bounded capability and observes its proof before dependent behavior, then continues under the existing testing method without another approval solely for crossing the planning/execution boundary.
graders.why_not_automated: Which files form the ANR observation capability versus dependent behavior is fixture-specific and not declared by the abstract fixture, and plan completeness is a semantic reading.
